metadata.description: SkyNET plugins for Claude Code: review council, usage-aware delegation, and engineering skills.

plugins.name: SkyNET-review
plugins.description: Four-lens code review (simplicity, functionality, security, maintainability), with fresh-context local subagents or a tribunal of external AI coding harnesses, merged into one verified, deduplicated report.

plugins.name: SkyNET-agents
